name: acad-router
description: AutoCAD MCP router - the single permanent entry point to ~30 specialist AutoCAD MCP categories (geometry-2d/3d, modify, layers, blocks, annotations, dimensions, layouts, files, parametric, architecture, mechanical, civil, electrical, vision, validators, workflows, livestream). Exposes 9 meta-tools: status, find_tools, load_category, recommend_categories, explain_capabilities, describe_drawing, undo_checkpoint, restore_checkpoint, design_iterate. The actual category MCPs are loaded on demand via MCP Nexus's mcpd_find / mcpd_connect flow. Backend talks to the AutoCAD .NET plugin (NETLOAD'ed) over a single named pipe.

tools_summary.name: acad_status
tools_summary.description: Lightweight health-check: AutoCAD alive, version, vertical (vanilla/civil3d/mechanical/architecture/MEP/plant3d), active document, layer, entity count, mode banner (full vs com-only).

tools_summary.name: acad_find_tools
tools_summary.description: Semantic search across all acad-* MCP servers via MCP Nexus find_tools, filtered to our namespace. Returns ranked candidates with category and tool name.

tools_summary.name: acad_load_category
tools_summary.description: Shortcut: connect to a single acad-<name> MCP server in lazy mode. Returns its tool list summary so you can pick the next call.

tools_summary.name: acad_recommend_categories
tools_summary.description: Suggest the 1-3 most relevant categories for a free-text task description. Saves tokens by avoiding indiscriminate loading.

tools_summary.name: acad_explain_capabilities
tools_summary.description: Returns a compact catalog of all known acad-* categories with one-line summaries.

tools_summary.name: acad_describe_drawing
tools_summary.description: Vision shortcut (Phase 4): screenshot active viewport + OCR + LLM-describe in one call.

tools_summary.name: acad_undo_checkpoint
tools_summary.description: Create a named undo checkpoint so subsequent operations can be rolled back atomically (Phase 7).

tools_summary.name: acad_restore_checkpoint
tools_summary.description: Roll back to a previously created checkpoint (Phase 7). Used by the auto-design loop on validation failure.

tools_summary.name: acad_design_iterate
tools_summary.description: Auto-design loop (Phase 7.0): create a checkpoint, execute a planned sequence of tool calls, validate against a named standard, auto-fix fixable violations or roll back on failure. Closes the 12-of-10 agent loop.
